from-the-future.title: Your settings were saved by a newer version
from-the-future.description: This build cannot read them, and will not overwrite them. Update Marble Trace to get your layouts and bindings back.

too-old.title: Your settings are too old to upgrade automatically
too-old.description: They were saved by a version too far back for this build to convert. The file has been left untouched.

corrupt.title: Your settings file could not be read
corrupt.description: It has been left untouched so it can be recovered by hand. Marble Trace is running on defaults and will not save over it.

settingsLock.resetConfirm: Replace the settings file with defaults? Layouts, widgets and bindings in it will be lost.

layoutEditor.applyLayoutTooltip: Apply this layout to the overlay
layoutEditor.monitorTooltip: Choose the screen to edit, or view them all at once. Picking a screen the layout does not cover yet adds it.

layoutList.title: Manage Widget Layouts
layoutList.subtitleAutoSwitch: Auto-switching is active. Layouts will load dynamically matching your game session.
layoutList.subtitleManual: Select a layout to see details. Double-click a card to open it in the editor.
layoutList.toggleAutoSwitchTooltip: Manual: one layout everywhere. Auto by session: layouts switch automatically per game session.
layoutList.activateDisabledAutoSwitch: Auto-Switching is on — layouts switch automatically based on session. Turn it off to activate manually.
layoutList.emptySelection: Select a layout to see details and actions
layoutList.removeMonitor: Remove this monitor from the layout

widgetSettings.fontScaleDesc: Scales only the text, independent of widget width/height

widgetDisplayOverride.title: Widget Display Override
widgetDisplayOverride.hideAllDesc: Global toggle to quickly hide or show all enabled UI elements.

startupBehavior.title: Startup Behavior
startupBehavior.launchMinimizedDesc: Start the application minimized to the taskbar.

interactionMode.title: Interaction Mode
interactionMode.dragModeDesc: Unlock widgets to move them freely across the screen.
interactionMode.interactModeDesc: Let the mouse reach the overlay (scrolling, buttons) without unlocking widget dragging. While it is on, the game does not receive the mouse.
interactionMode.interactHotkeyModeDesc: Toggle switches the mode on and off, Hold keeps it on only while the key is pressed.
interactionMode.interactAutoOffDesc: Turn interact mode off automatically so the mouse returns to the game.

gameIntegration.title: Game Integration
gameIntegration.autoHideDesc: Hide widgets when the simulator is not running.

steeringLock.title: Steering Wheel
steeringLock.rangeDesc: Physical range of your wheel: {{full}}° (±{{half}}°). Shared by every widget that shows steering.

applicationUpdates.title: Application Updates
applicationUpdates.autoCheckDesc: Automatically check for new versions on application startup.
applicationUpdates.checkIntervalDesc: How often to check for updates while the app is running.
applicationUpdates.upToDate: Your application is up to date.

trackMap.title: Track Map
trackMap.reRecordDesc: Clears current map data and starts fresh on next lap crossing or manual trigger.
trackMap.manualStartActive: Manual start active. Drive to begin recording.
trackMap.pitLaneCalibrationDescWithTrack: Clears pit entry/exit points recorded for "{{track}}". Drive through the pit lane again to re-calibrate.
trackMap.pitLaneCalibrationDescNoTrack: No track loaded. Load a session to reset pit lane data for the active track.
trackMap.pitLaneResetSuccess: Pit lane data cleared. Drive through pit lane to re-calibrate.
trackMap.referenceLapDescWithCar: Deletes the stored best lap for "{{car}}" on the current track. Recording restarts on the next completed lap.
trackMap.referenceLapDescNoSession: No session loaded. Load a session to delete the reference lap for the active track and car.
trackMap.referenceLapDeleteSuccess: Reference lap deleted. Recording restarts on the next completed lap.

reset.title: Reset
reset.resetAllDesc: Clears all widget positions, sizes, and preferences. The app will restart automatically.
reset.confirmDescription: Widget layout and all preferences will be lost.

developerTools.title: Developer Tools
developerTools.snapshotSuccess: Snapshot saved — place the JSON in test-data/

streamChat.title: Stream chat
streamChat.twitchChannelDesc: Only the name from the channel address: twitch.tv/twitchdev → twitchdev. Read anonymously, no account needed. Leave empty to disable Twitch.
streamChat.youtubeTargetDesc: Any of these works: @MrBeast, youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ, youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ, or just dQw4w9WgXcQ. Given a channel, the current live stream is found automatically.
streamChat.hideCommandsDesc: Drops messages starting with an exclamation mark.
streamChat.ignoredBotsDesc: Comma separated. Their messages never reach the widget.
streamChat.signInDesc: Optional. Unlocks the viewer count and stream uptime in the footer — chat itself works without it.
streamChat.clientIdDesc: This build has no client id, so sign-in needs your own application from dev.twitch.tv/console/apps. Register it as a Public client; no client secret is needed.
streamChat.deviceHint: Enter this code on twitch.tv/activate, then come back — this window updates itself.

errors.clientIdRequired: Fill in the client id first.
errors.sessionExpired: The Twitch session expired. Sign in again.

bindings.title: Input bindings
bindings.intro: Keys and controller buttons work app-wide, in every layout. Bindings that clash with the sim’s own controls cannot be detected here — check them in iRacing.
bindings.resetConfirm: Reset every binding to its default?
bindings.deviceOffline: Device not connected — the binding is kept.
bindings.captureTitle: Press a key or a device button
bindings.captureHint: Press Escape to cancel. Nothing is saved until you press something.

actions.pitServiceToggle: Open the order box away from the pit lane (temporary)
actions.pitServiceAutoMode: Hand this stop to auto mode, or take it back
actions.pitServiceApplyOrder: Order a full stop: calculated fuel and all four tyres (replaces the current order)
actions.pitServiceFuel: Add the calculated amount of fuel
actions.pitServiceFuelPlus: Add a litre (a gallon in imperial) to the fuel order
actions.pitServiceFuelMinus: Take a litre (a gallon in imperial) off the fuel order
actions.pitServiceFuelPlanned: Order the calculated fuel and hand the fuel back to auto mode

bindings.devicesIntro: Wheels, button boxes, joysticks and pedals are detected automatically. A device you have bound something to stays listed while it is unplugged, so its bindings are not lost.
bindings.notInLayoutTooltip: The widget is not in the active layout, so nothing it owns runs — neither its bindings nor its background work, such as automatic pit orders. The show / hide key is the exception: it is what puts the widget back.
bindings.toggleHint: Toggles the box: press again to take it back off the order.

inert.pitServiceAutoMode: Does nothing until Auto fuel or Auto tyres is switched on in the widget settings.
inert.pitServiceFuelPlanned: Does nothing until the Fuel widget has a figure to work from.

bindings.searchByKeyHint: Press a key or a device button and the list shows what it is bound to.
bindings.searchPressKey: Press a key or a device button…
